## Où j'en suis
Webhook PR #405 was closed (private app tokens can't manage HubSpot webhook subscriptions) and replaced by a polling approach on branch `daniel/hubspot-owner-sync`: CRM search every 15 min with windowed paging past the 10k results cap, syncing owner + ARR only for companies with ARR > 0. PR #409 was opened with auto-merge set, but the e2e check fails and the PR is still open, not merged.

- [en-cours] PR #409 open with auto-merge blocked on a failing e2e check.
- [prochaine-étape] Fix `tests/e2e/test_admin_accounts.py::test_accounts_table_shows_owner` (fixture has a trial company with an owner; the new ARR > 0 filter skips it — expected 3 rows, got 2).
- [prochaine-étape] Noa to add `HUBSPOT_TOKEN` to AWS Secrets Manager for staging/prod.
- [essai-raté] Webhook subscription via API: 401, private app tokens unsupported for subscription management.
- [essai-raté] Initial backfill hit the 10k search paging cap; fixed with windowed paging (commit 2d90ac4).
- [décision] Skip trials entirely, only sync companies with arr > 0 (source: t10).
